notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Doppelganger on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Vesuvan Doppelganger do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
